::: {#exm-door-dfa}
#### The door as a DFA

Choosing the accepting states $F = \set{\text{open}}$ makes the door (@exm-door-machine) a DFA (@def-dfa), $D$,
drawn in @fig-door-dfa.
It accepts (@def-accept) the strings after which the door is open.
For example, it accepts $\mathtt{o}$, $\mathtt{luo}$ and $\mathtt{ol}$,
whose runs end at open,
and rejects $\lambda$, $\mathtt{oc}$ and $\mathtt{lo}$,
whose runs end at closed, closed and locked.

::: {#fig-door-dfa}

The door as a DFA whose one accepting state is open.
